title: Independently prove conditional selected residual/CALL refinement
body:
## Summary

Independently audit the all-width residual/CALL implication in the retained PR2809 bit caller, taking PR2989's released handoff.

```text
literal residual blocks
  preserve source requests, coordinates and odd half-reset spectators
internal child
  copy the complete capsule before releasing borrowed event words
  substitute one completed child packet
return
  restore the parent and resume its saved successor PC
```

`research/residual-call-refinement/PROOF.md` states the quantified relative theorem. An independent integer-address oracle, literal encoded Layout checks and actual selected-descriptor protocol fixtures supply finite evidence. The construction and grammar retain Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml and David Arias's credit; full predecessor lineage is in the package. This is an independent audit, not a new construction or selected exponent.

## Evidence

- Before: the source's construction and finite cursor comparisons were available; the separate whole-word audit PR2989 left residual/CALL refinement as a handoff.
- After: 100 grammar cases cover 45,896 events and 540 blocks; 90 encoded geometries preserve ordered spectators and volume; eight selected-descriptor fixtures preserve source/directory bytes, flags, grants, fresh rows and parent state. Four literal emitter mutants, lost source/directory and wrong-PC controls reject. Six behavioral test groups pass normally and with `-O`.
- Reproduce with `uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/residual-call-refinement`. Exact base, 132 input pins and typed receipt are included. Direct replay took 41.85 s locally. Registered replay and lint pass; all 146 package/input publication-byte checks pass against commit `b89c9eef729eb1e5889e2095d59a6fbf4738447d`. The package validation note records the local environment and limits.

The all-width argument assumes completed operations/children, canonical inputs, recursive stock and inverse parking. Recursive closure additionally needs the enclosing node correspondence. Finite protocol fixtures use opaque 23-bit results; fallback dispatch cutoff 2 and q=3 outside the source-admitted large-prime domain are explicit. They do not execute the full selected GL64 payload. No physical cost/reserve, supplier admission, interruption recovery, formal verification or kappa improvement is claimed. Selected result and frozen inputs are unchanged.

Canonical claim/finding: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18982149

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only the new opt-in research package is added. Shared code and selected-frontier records are unchanged.
